pipelines.yaml:
name: dev
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest -q
  deploy:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: dev
    steps:
      - run: echo desplegar a dev con ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}

name: staging
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest -q
  deploy:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: staging
    steps:
      - run: echo desplegar a staging con ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}

name: prod
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt && pytest -q
  deploy:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: prod
    steps:
      - run: echo desplegar a prod con ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_TOKEN }}

gates.criterio: aprobación del Release Manager en día de release permitido

promocion.criterio: smoke test en staging y ventana de release vigente
